hyperedges.label: Storage Backend Selection: OPFS Probe → wa-sqlite or Dexie Fallback
Transaction Integrity: Worker BEGIN/COMMIT + Dexie.transaction → R9 No Corruption
Offline-First Guarantee: SW Precache + dbReady Gate + local-first arch

nodes.label: Local-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: All user data lives in the browser (OPFS → IndexedDB fallback). The app works offline after the first load. Cloud features are opt-in and deferred to a later slice. Rationale: no server required for day-to-day use, single user, reduced toolchain cost vs native.

nodes.label: Strict TDD Mode (Jest)
nodes.rationale: strict_tdd: true with test_runner: jest and test_command: npm test. Enforces test-first discipline across all apply and verify phases.

nodes.label: Brain / Skin Codebase Split
nodes.rationale: Brain (lib/, stores/, db/schema.ts, db/repositories/, types/) reused 1:1 unchanged because storage and presentation are already separated from logic. Skin (app/ screens + components/) rewritten from RN primitives to HTML/JSX + Tailwind. Rationale: minimise risky changes, preserve repo contracts.

nodes.label: wa-sqlite + OPFS Engine
nodes.rationale: Chosen over sql.js (no durable OPFS) and absurd-sql (unmaintained). Maintained WASM SQLite with first-class OPFS and sync-access-handle VFS. Requires crossOriginIsolated.

nodes.label: Dexie/IndexedDB Primary iOS Fallback
nodes.rationale: iOS Safari often lacks sync access handle (iOS ≤16.3), making Dexie the EXPECTED path on many iPhones, not an edge case. Rejected IDBBatchAtomicVFS bridge as fragile/slow on iOS Safari. Dexie adapter re-implements all 3 repo contracts against flat IndexedDB tables.

nodes.label: drizzle-orm/sqlite-proxy Binding
nodes.rationale: Official escape hatch so schema + repos see an identical db object. Requires a custom transaction facade because the plain async-proxy driver does NOT provide an interactive tx callback.

nodes.label: React Router v7 (createBrowserRouter)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over TanStack Router. Only ~6 flat routes, no nested-layout depth or type-safe-search needs that justify TanStack's heavier API + route codegen. React Router maps 1:1 to existing routes, lowest migration cost.

nodes.label: db.transaction() Facade (Worker BEGIN/COMMIT)
nodes.source_location: CRITICAL: Transactions across the Worker boundary
nodes.rationale: mealEntries.ts uses db.transaction() at lines 53 and 70. sqlite-proxy has no interactive tx callback. Resolution: thin facade in db/client.ts adds real transaction(fn) whose tx is a drizzle-proxy bound to the same Worker, with Worker serializing statements between BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK. Zero repo changes required.

nodes.label: From-Scratch Web Migrator (Vite ?raw)
nodes.rationale: expo migrator is RN-only and incompatible with sqlite-proxy. Web migrator imports .sql files via Vite ?raw, splits on --> statement-breakpoint, tracks in __drizzle_migrations table with hash drift guard.

nodes.label: COOP/COEP Headers (crossOriginIsolated)
nodes.rationale: Required for OPFS sync VFS (OPFSCoopSyncVFS). Configured per host: Vercel vercel.json, Netlify _headers/netlify.toml, Cloudflare Pages _headers. If absent or iOS lacks VFS, probe fails → Dexie fallback.

nodes.label: Offline Guard at UI/Store-Caller Layer
nodes.rationale: Guard placed at UI layer, not inside lib/openFoodFacts.ts, because lib/ is reused 1:1 and must not be touched. SearchRoute checks navigator.onLine before invoking store's search().

nodes.label: dbReady Promise Gate (main.tsx)
nodes.rationale: main.tsx awaits dbReady before mounting RouterProvider. Repos must not run before migrations complete.

nodes.label: Data Flow: Screen → Zustand → Repos → db facade
nodes.rationale: Screens dispatch actions to Zustand stores, which call db/repositories, which call the db facade. The facade routes to either wa-sqlite Worker (OPFS) or Dexie/IndexedDB depending on probe result.

nodes.rationale: ~2100-2600 estimated changed lines, high 400-line budget risk. Three chained PRs stacked to main: PR1 scaffold+storage, PR2 screens+components, PR3 PWA shell+deploy. Each PR merges to main in order.
